title: AST SpaceMobile’s 2025 Highlights
summary: In 2025, AST SpaceMobile launched the first of its next-generation satellites, BlueBird 6. In addition, this year saw strengthened global partnerships, expanded U.S. manufacturing, and the building of a robust spectrum portfolio to support rapid growth ahead.
